scope: One completion-order ablation, no policy tuning after inspection
seed_use: Reuse T2 development blocks; not independent validation
change: Only checkpoint child-queue ordering; outer byte DRR weights and all wire formats, repair policy, queue bounds and controls unchanged
focus_selection: Keep one focus while it has eligible active transfers and its 1s lease has not expired. For a new focus prefer a validated received repair request; otherwise oldest started transfer then oldest queued transfer. On expiry prefer another queued checkpoint if available.
transfer_order: Within focus finish selected transfer before others; otherwise started transfer then smallest remaining dependency. Association is enqueue-origin checkpoint, not perfect knowledge of shared revision dependencies.
fairness: At most4092 priority bytes before one original round-robin checkpoint fragment; account payload and header, conservatively allow 4 B shared header when selecting; outer DRR still bounds group service. No service credit or bytes borrowed from another group beyond ordinary idle borrowing.
correctness: Exact checkpoint reconstruction, monotonic promotion, confirmation before Pong, bounded payload/partial memory; all 13 controls complete; positive measured checkpoint progress
primary_hypothesis: p95 checkpoint age lower than unchanged 2:1:1 in both limited-link counts, without regression in guarded metrics in any of 6 cells
analysis: Exact paired differences with both controls, retain bytes/correctionproxy tradeoffs; no aggregate weighted score, epsilon, confidence interval or statistical winner; exploratory only
baseline_check: Rerun original rotation and unchanged 2:1:1 must exactly match 12 T2 rawcases after removing only scope and execution_ordinal
stop: Stop after 18 runs and report support or rejection; no other ablations, new seeds, T4, live integration or compression/rate/weight changes
